تضطهدوا (form VIII)
# تَضْطَهِدُوا (taḍṭahidū) /tadˤ.tˤa.hi.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
# تُضْطَهَدُوا (tuḍṭahadū) /tudˤ.tˤa.ha.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
